Add keyword-only on_error=None to map_except/filter_except, reporting zero-based input index, original item and actual caught exception once per listed conversion failure. Add sessionize(iterable,key,gap) yielding ordered lists of original events. Start a new session only when consecutive event gap is STRICTLY greater than nonnegative numeric/timedelta gap, preserving identity and source order; equality stays in session. Support one-shot/empty/duplicate/cross-day inputs, reject observed reverse timestamps and negative gap, propagate incompatible key/arithmetic errors. Use no real clock and keep only current session plus lookahead, with documented full-session memory.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_more_itertools_02_dev.py, and Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-more-itertools-02-dev.md. Add windowed_time(iterable,key,span) yielding a tuple of original events for each consumed event, inclusive interval [event_time-span,event_time]. Nondecreasing timestamp requirement, positive numeric/timedelta span, duplicates remain separate input-ordered events. Evict expired items before output, retain no full history, support sparse/empty/cross-day streams and propagate invalid order/arithmetic. Event time only, no clock or fake constant-memory claim when many events share span.

Add asof_join(left,right,key,*,right_key=None,tolerance=None,default=None) yielding (left event,last right event whose time <= left time). Equal right timestamps select last input version; optional nonnegative tolerance inclusive, explicit unmatched default. Preserve original identities, one-shot ordering, separate right key, empty streams and finite lookahead memory. Reject reverse timestamps as observed; do not eagerly validate unconsumed tail, sort entire streams or use nearest future values. No dependency on equality join.

Add sized_iterator(...,strict=False) with opt-in exact observed-length validation. Strict nonnegative integer declaration, preserve fixed __len__ as declared length and lazy consumption. At premature exhaustion raise ValueError, or consume first extra item then raise before yielding it; previously valid prefix may already be delivered. After mismatch become exhausted, do not repeatedly consume. Exact/zero lengths pass; default remains unchecked historical behavior. Early consumer stop cannot claim full-length validation.
